name: HaloAudit
tagline: A desktop and web tool that analyses data files to automate parts of an audit.
problem: Organisations spend heavily on manual audit review.
solution: A cross-platform app (Electron, Swift, web) analyses uploaded data with Gemini and LangGraph and presents insights.
demo_moment: Team-described: load a data file and read the audit findings.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Gemini API” among 160 submissions.
Runs natively on desktop as well as the web.

lessons: Shipping on several platforms can carry an AI-API prize.
